V9.0

通过我的最新更新加快了此工作流程：

西格玛：

  • 旧的 sigma 调度程序是为 Krea2 设置的。我为此更新了它，调整了设置并改进了选择

灯光控制：

  • 添加了我的照明控制模块，允许您在生成图像后调整光和影的方向

🎨 后期处理：

版本6.0

  • Controlnet/图像参考区域、肠道和重建：

  • 更好的提示生成器（佛罗伦萨）

  • 巨大的更新细节设计师。我基本上把它们拉出来并用我的 V5 装置替换它们。

    • 您可以使用 Flux 或使用基于 SDXL 的模型来进行详细设计。切换一下就可以了

  • 更新了🎨后期制作套件包括真实感增强器和内联裁剪工具

  • 更新了主要区域

  • 🗒️巨大更新笔记。

Brought this workflow up to speed with my latest updates:

Sigmas:

  • The old sigma scheduler was set for Krea2. I updated it for this, adjusted settings, and improved choices

Lighting Control:

  • Added my ighting control module which allows you to adjust teh directions of light and shadows after the image is generated

🎨 Post Processing:

  • Brought this up to speed with my new nodes and modifications

Ver 8.0

Major overhaul

  • literally built custom nodes for this.

  • Updated Image area

  • Better controlnet

  • better latent recognition

  • Completly redone Sampler group

  • Improved LLM

  • Redid teh detailers

  • LC123 Post production Suite.

  • Better Save nodes.

Ver 6.0

  • Controlnet/ Image reference area, gut & rebuild:

    • you can now set the image ratio based on your original image. Huge timesaver for Controlnet & I2I

    • Base image 🖼️ controls everything, so no need to set multiple images

    • You can even use it as acolor referencein post processing

  • Better Prompt generator(Florence)

  • Huge update todetailers. I basically yanked them out and replaced them with my V5 units.

    • You an use Flux or use an SDXL based model to detail. Just switch it.

  • Updated 🎨post production suitethat includes realism enhancers and an inline crop tool

  • Updated the main area

  • Huge update to 🗒️notes.

  • Added controlnet

  • Added a sentence remover to prevent CivitAi Flags

  • Total overhaul
